* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will work on real\-world, high\-impact projects across a variety of industries, identify micro patterns in data that our clients can exploit to maintain their competitive advantage and watch your technical solutions transform their day\-to\-day business.
   

  

 You will experience the best environment to grow as a technologist and a leader, develop a sought\-after perspective connecting technology and business value by working on real\-life problems across a variety of industries and technical challenges to serve our clients on their changing needs. You will be surrounded by inspiring individuals as part of diverse multidisciplinary teams, develop a holistic perspective of AI by partnering with the best design, technical, and business talent in the world as your team members.
   

  

 As a Data Scientist, you will:
   

  

* Partner with our clients, from data owners and users to C\-level executives, to understand their needs and build impactful analytics solutions.
* Contribute to cross\-functional problem\-solving sessions with your team and deliver presentations to colleagues and clients.
* Translate business problems into analytical problems and develop models aimed at solving our clients’ and users’ problems and ensure they are evaluated with the relevant metrics.
* Write highly optimized code to advance our internal Data Science Toolbox.
* Add real\-world impact to your academic expertise, as you are encouraged to write papers and present at meetings and conferences should you wish.
* Take part in R\&D projects; attend conferences such as NIPS and ICML as well as data science retrospectives where you will have the opportunity to share and learn from your co\-workers.
* Work in one of the most advanced data science teams globally.
* Work on the frameworks and libraries that our teams of data scientists and data engineers use to progress from data to impact.
* Guide global companies through data science solutions to transform their businesses and enhance performance across industries including healthcare, automotive, energy and elite sport.


 You will be part of our global Data Science community, and you will work with other data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers and project managers on interdisciplinary projects, using math, stats and machine learning to derive structure and knowledge from raw data across various industry sectors.
   

  

 You are a highly collaborative individual who can lay aside your own agenda, listening to and learning from colleagues, challenging thoughtfully and prioritizing impact. You search for ways to improve things and work collaboratively with colleagues. You believe in iterative change, experimenting with new approaches, learning and improving to move forward quickly.
   

  

**Our Tech Stack**
 While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Python, PySpark, the PyData stack, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, our own open\-source data pipelining framework called Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, cloud solutions such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and more.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Bachelors, master’s or PhD level in disciplines such as computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
* 2\-5 years of professional experience in applying machine learning and data mining techniques to real problems with copious amounts of data
* Programming experience (focus on machine learning): SQL and Python’s Data Science stack are a must; good knowledge of at least one big data framework (Pyspark, Hive, Hadoop) is a plus; R, SPSS, SAS (nice to have); Software Engineering is a plus
* Ability to prototype statistical analysis and modeling algorithms and apply these algorithms for data driven solutions to problems in new domains
* Experience deploying technology applied to business problems is a plus
* Knowledge in applying machine learning solutions to real problems with complex and/or big amounts of data.
* Willingness to travel

title: Data Scientist
description:
Silicon Quantum Computing is pioneering the future of quantum technology. As the world’s first company to manufacture qubits with atomic precision, we’re delivering quantum advantage today, not decades from now.
 



  





 Founded by Professor Michelle Simmons, one of the world’s leading materials scientists, SQC has achieved major breakthroughs including the first single\-atom transistor and the first integrated circuit built with atomic precision. Our Chair, Simon Segars, former CEO of ARM, brings deep global experience as we scale our technology and commercial impact.
 



  





 Our quantum machine learning chip, Watermelon, is already accelerating AI in ways classical systems can’t match. We’re generating significant revenue and working closely with multinational partners to solve complex problems with quantum solutions.
 



  





 SQC is a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment where people grow quickly and contribute meaningfully. If you’re excited by deep tech, ambitious about your career, and ready to help shape the future of computing, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We’re hiring a Data Scientist to design and deliver advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that leverage both classical and quantum computing capabilities. Based at our UNSW Sydney office, you’ll work within the Software Engineering team and collaborate with quantum engineers, hardware specialists, and customer organisations to build data\-driven models that solve high\-impact problems.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who thrives on extracting insights from complex datasets and is curious about applying quantum\-enhanced approaches to real\-world challenges. You’ll work with internal and external teams to deliver tailored, outcome\-driven solutions across industries such as telecommunications, defence, finance, pharmaceuticals and more.
 



  





**Role responsibilities** 




  




* Design, develop, and deploy data science models for classification, prediction, and optimisation tasks.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external customers to define use cases and deliver fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Translate business requirements into technical problem statements and modelling strategies.
* Build and optimise data pipelines for large\-scale analytics and machine learning workflows.
* Advise customer teams on model selection, tuning, and integration with advanced computing platforms.
* Work closely with quantum physicists and software engineers to explore quantum\-enhanced data science techniques.
* Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and methodologies to improve performance and scalability.
* Stay current with emerging trends in data science, machine learning, and quantum computing.



  





**Your experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven track record in developing and deploying data science models with measurable business impact.
* Strong understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms, and optimisation techniques.
* Proficiency in Python and data science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and big data technologies.
* Familiarity with data engineering practices and pipeline development.
* Ability to define clear problem statements and select appropriate modelling approaches.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Exposure to quantum computing concepts is desirable but not essential.



  





**The recruitment process** 




  





 For roles at SQC, expect 3\-4 interviews, meeting a few members of the team and focusing on your core eligibility for the role, your skills and how they align, and finally your values and how they align. We'll give you a more specific runthrough if you're successful in making it to the first interview.
 



  





 As part of our obligations to our clients, we require that successful candidates submit to background checks, including a National Police Check, Right to Work checks, as well as employment and qualifications verification. We won't contact anyone until we're confident there's a fit between SQC and yourself.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 The best and simplest way is to apply directly here, rather than messaging anyone on the SQC team directly. If you have any questions that you'd like answered before committing to applying, please feel free to email us at careers@sqc.com.au.
 



  





**Please note** 




  





 This position may require access to export\-controlled information (ECI) subject to EAR and ITAR. Final employment decision is contingent upon satisfactory completion of export control screenings and obtaining any necessary export licenses or approvals, based on nationality, citizenship, and other factors considered by applicable export control regulations.
 



  





 Silicon Quantum Computing (SQC) does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from recruitment agencies without a signed agreement in place. Any such submissions will be considered the property of SQC, and no fees will be payable for candidates introduced without prior written consent and agreed terms. Agencies must have a valid, executed agreement with SQC before submitting candidates for consideration.

 We are looking for an exceptional Data Scientist with 3\+ years of experience to help Uber's internal and external applications, products and services to grow adoption, improve CSAT and reduce cost. You will leverage analytics, engineering, and machine learning, and data science to empower data\-driven decision making in the full lifecycle of product development. You will be responsible for building this program from the ground up: partner with stakeholders, understand all aspects of the products, interact with cross\-functional business and technical teams, predict risks, improve strategic decisions, and lead experimentation/growth projects.

* Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and statistical modeling to deliver impactful, objective, and actionable data insights that enable informed business and product decisions
* Define, measure, and analyze business metrics and product KPIs
* Create tableau dashboards and the underlying data aggregations in GCP.

* Experience in applying both data\-backed heuristics and machine\-learning techniques to solve practical product problems such as customer lifetime value models, funnel optimization.

* Expertise using data modeling skills to identify key product trends and new product opportunities
* Ability to design implement, and track core metrics to analyze the performance of our products

* Demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges

description:
Voleon is a technology company that applies state\-of\-the\-art AI and machine learning techniques to real\-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion\-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.
   

  

 Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals.
   

  

 In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more.
   

  

 The Voleon Group is forming a new team to help advance our data\-driven investment initiatives. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for harvesting insights from a complex array of data. Your role will involve data curation, analysis, interpretation, visualization, and communication of your findings to members of the research staff and executive leadership. This role is a means to make a difference: as a machine learning company, data insights are essential to our business.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and implement systems to ensure data correctness and monitor data health in data stores and live feeds
* Proactively identify abnormal production behavior and communicate them clearly to relevant stakeholders
* Perform extemporaneous analyses on research and production trading systems with leadership
* Harness financial expertise and statistical analysis to gain actionable insights into our production trading and research systems
* Design and implement analysis pipelines that automate those analyses found to be valuable for ongoing monitoring


**Requirements**
* 1\+ years of applied end\-to\-end industry experience, including internships working with complex datasets, including curation, querying, aggregation, exploratory data analysis, and visualization
* Experience using statistical methods to analyze data, identify patterns, conduct root cause analysis, discover insights, and recommend solutions
* Ability to frame and answer questions mathematically
* Ability to infer useful forward\-looking directions from results of retrospective analysis

title: Data Scientist
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states.
   

  

 Rigorous performance evaluation of the Waymo Driver is a critical part of scaling our ride hailing service and achieving Waymo’s audacious goals. Waymo data scientists work hand\-in\-hand with engineering teams at each stage of the software development cycle, employing statistical models and developing metrics and measurement frameworks to ensure that the Waymo Driver meets our strict standards for safety, compliance, and driving and service quality. Autonomous driving presents a new paradigm in data science: in addition to leveraging data collected on\-road, we generate our own data using state\-of\-the\-art simulation technology—resulting in denser signals and challenging new problems in estimation and experimental design.
   

  

 In this hybrid role you will report to a Data Science Manager.
   

  

**You Will**
* Develop evaluation frameworks for autonomous vehicle performance, for large\-scale ML models, and for the quality of simulation.
* Develop new metrics, interpret trends, and investigate anomalies in data from simulation and on\-road driving.
* Develop novel statistical methods to handle unique aspects of AV data; e.g. rate estimation with rare events, combining real and synthetic data, etc.
* Frame and solve ambiguous problems, derive data\-driven conclusions, and communicate findings to senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering partners developing the Waymo Driver and Waymo’s simulation software; facilitate deployment readiness decisions for both products.


**You Have**
* Degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Statistics, Mathematics, Physics)
* 3\+ years of industry experience solving data science problems or a PhD in a quantitative field
* Expertise using advanced statistical methods in an applied setting; familiarity with ML systems/models
* Demonstrated knowledge of Python/SQL/R data analysis libraries and packages


**We Prefer**
* PhD in a quantitative field
* Experience solving problems related to Autonomous Driving or Ride Hailing
* Experience in adjacent relevant areas like Advanced Machine Learning (Deep Learning and Diffusion models), Traffic Modeling, Safety Evaluation or Prediction

title: Data Scientist con 5 años de experiencia
description:
Qué harás

A corto plazo, participarás en dos proyectos: un detector de anomalías para un gestor de plantas renovables y un proyecto para una gran cadena de gimnasios.

En esos proyectos:

* Liderarás el planteamiento de los modelos de Machine Learning a aplicar y las métricas a utilizar, en los proyectos que participes, así como de su puesta en producción.
* Te encargarás del desarrollo end\-to\-end de los proyectos en los que participes: extraer los datos (Big Query, Redshift), realizar el EDA (usando Plotly), entrenar los modelos (con pipelines de Sklearn), crear una aplicación con FastAPI y Dash para consumir el modelo, si es necesario y desplegar la solución en la infraestructura del cliente (Docker, Dokploy, Cloud Run, etc.). Todo ello, quedará encapsulado en una librería de Python instalable, documentada y testada.

Además del trabajo en proyectos, te encargarás de dar soporte a los científicos de datos con menor experiencia dentro del equipo.

Qué pedimos

* Experiencia de al menos 5 años trabajando en proyectos de datos/IA/ML.
* Ser capaz de desarrollar código limpio, entendible y mantenible en Python. Nuestros proyectos son propiedad de nuestros clientes, así que debemos crear soluciones robustas, mantenibles y profesionales.
* Experiencia en el planteamiento y desarrollo de modelos de ML. Ante todo, en DECIDATA solucionamos problemas de negocio con IA, ML, Analítica Avanzada. Tenemos proyectos de predicción numérica, clasificación, RAGs, optimizadores… Contar con experiencia a la hora de crear modelos de ML, crear Pipelines robustos que facilitan la puesta en producción, saber identificar y resolver posibles problemas antes de abordar un proyecto es imprescindible.
* Conocimiento de creación de APIs y Frontends. No somos desarrolladores full\-stack, pero a veces tenemos que crear APIs y Fronts para que el cliente pueda consumir nuestra aplicación. Necesitamos que te hayas peleado creando algún que otro front (nosotros usamos Dash, pero si has trabajado con otro framework o con HTML y CSS puro es válido) y tengas experiencia en la creación de APIs (nosotros usamos FastAPI, pero si has trabajado con otro framework no hay problema).
* Conocimiento de Infra \& despliegue. Al igual que no somos full\-stack, tampoco somos devops. Sin embargo, tenemos que desplegar los proyectos en la infra del cliente. Hemos trabajado con Google Cloud, Azure, despliegues en VMs…
* Soft skills: capacidad de trabajar en equipo, ser autónomo en la ejecución de tareas, de liderar reuniones técnicas con cliente, tener ganas de seguir aprendiendo y mejorando, etc.

Qué ofrecemos

* Paquete salarial de 50\.700€ compuesto por: sueldo de 43\.000€ brutos/año, 10% de bonus y 3\.000€ para formación.
* Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes.
* 23 días de vacaciones al año \+ el día de tu cumpleaños libre. Libertad para organizarte tus vacaciones.
* Plan de Carrera definido con criterios claros y objetivos para evolucionar dentro de la compañía.
* Comida gratis los días que vengas a la oficina y el mejor pintxo de tortilla los días que estamos todos juntos.
* Formación continua: reuniones semanales dentro del equipo técnico para compartir conocimientos generados en los proyectos (technical stuff), formación mensual dentro de la compañía y 3\.000€ de presupuesto al año para que puedas formarte.
* Acompañamiento en tu carrera profesional por una persona con más experiencia. One\-to\-one semanal, reuniones trimestrales de seguimiento con el CEO para evaluar tu evolución profesional.

Dónde lo harás

Nuestras oficinas están ubicadas en Bilbao y valoramos la cultura de equipo que se genera en la oficina, por lo que nuestra preferencia es un modelo de trabajo híbrido.

Es importante destacar que, independientemente de la modalidad, el puesto implica visitas ocasionales a las oficinas de nuestros clientes en etapas estratégicas de los proyectos.

Cómo lo harás

Nos organizamos mediante metodologías ágiles, fomentando la transparencia y la comunicación continua entre todos los involucrados:

\- Todos los lunes realizamos una reunión de coordinación para planificar la semana en la que se definen las tareas a desarrollar por cada uno.

\- Utilizamos Jira y Teams como herramientas para la comunicación y la gestión de proyectos.

Tendrás autonomía para planificar y ejecutar tus tareas, con el apoyo de equipos de negocio y técnicos siempre que lo necesites.

Creemos en la confianza y en la responsabilidad compartida, donde cada persona aporta su experiencia para el éxito colectivo.

Si disfrutas convirtiendo los retos de negocio en soluciones de IA de alto impacto y te motiva aportar tu visión en cada fase del proyecto, DECIDATA es el lugar perfecto para ti. ¡Te esperamos!

Gridsight builds the analytics platform that makes this possible. At Minga, we’re creating the Student Behavior Platform schools can’t imagine running without. We’re on a mission to make school life run smoother and have fun while we’re at it.

Growth – We’re always learning and evolving, individually and as a team

Integrity – We do what’s right, even when it’s hard

* Equitable compensation and pay transparency on all roles
* Flexible paid time off including vacation \+ additional personal days

**Sound like your kind of place? Apply now, we’d love to meet you.**

At Minga, we don’t take it lightly that you’re considering us as your next move and we treat every application with the care and attention it deserves. You won’t be left wondering if your resume disappeared into the void. Every application is reviewed by a real person on our team.  

  

We’ll keep you in the loop, communicate clearly, and make sure you feel seen and respected throughout the process.

Let’s build something meaningful together.

As an Industrial Commissioning Automation Lead, your role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless commissioning and start\-up of complex industrial facilities, with a primary focus on automation and control systems. Reporting to the commissioning lead, your responsibilities encompass leading the automation commissioning team, overseeing various aspects including cause and effect engineering verifications, Control Narrative verifications, client interface management, PLC/DCS programming changes, HMI graphic reviews, alarm summary reviews, serial interface verifications and engineering management, IP address allocations, and mapping assignments. Your multidisciplinary expertise is essential in achieving optimal automation system performance and ensuring client satisfaction.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* **Strategic Planning:** Collaborate with the project leads and stakeholders to align automation commissioning strategies with project objectives, timelines, and budget constraints; Develop comprehensive commissioning plans and strategies for automation and control systems, encompassing serial interfaces, IP address allocations, and mapping assignments; Meet alignment of automation activities with overall project goals; Ensure automation support and vendor specific automation man power is scheduled and managed during the commissioning life cycle.
* **Leadership and Team Management:** Lead, mentor, and manage the automation commissioning team, including programmers and control engineers; Efficiently allocate resources, tasks, and responsibilities to optimize automation commissioning activities; Foster a culture of collaboration, safety, quality, and accountability within the automation teams.
* **Cause and Effect Engineering Verifications:** Oversee and verify the cause and effect engineering for automation and control systems; Ensure that automation systems respond correctly to various conditions and sequences; Collaborate with the engineering team to resolve discrepancies or issues in the cause and effect logic.
* **Control Narrative Verifications:** Verify that control narratives accurately reflect the intended operation of the automation systems; Review and validate the control logic against control narratives; Coordinate with the engineering team to maintain alignment between control narratives and control strategies.
* **Client Interface Management:** Manage client interface for programming\-related activities, including serial interface requirements and IP address allocations; Ensure that client expectations regarding serial interfaces and IP address assignments are met or exceeded; Collaborate closely with clients and project stakeholders to address inquiries or concerns related to the project automation.
* **PLC/DCS Programming Changes and Maintenance:** Lead programming changes for PLC/DCS systems to address functional requirements, optimizations; Oversee maintenance and modification of control software, ensuring system reliability and efficiency; Coordinate programming changes with the engineering team, control systems vendors, and IP address allocations.
* **HMI Graphic Reviews:** Review and validate HMI graphics for clarity, functionality, and alignment with operational requirements; Provide feedback to clients on HMI graphics and collaborate to implement improvements; Ensure that HMI graphics enhance operator efficiency and situational awareness.
* **Alarm Summary Reviews:** Review and validate alarm summaries and events; Ensure that alarm systems are configured effectively to prioritize critical alerts; Collaborate with the engineering team to address alarm\-related issues or discrepancies.
* **Serial Interface Verifications and Engineering Management:** Oversee the verification and testing of serial interfaces to ensure proper data exchange and communication; Manage the engineering aspects of serial interfaces, addressing hardware and software requirements; Collaborate with vendors and contractors to ensure serial interface compliance and functionality.
* **IP Address Allocations and Mapping Assignments:** Manage the allocation of IP addresses for automation and control systems; Maintain an organized mapping of IP addresses to devices and systems, ensuring proper communication; Coordinate IP address assignments with the IT team and vendors, addressing any conflicts or requirements.

* Extensive experience in commissioning and start\-up activities, with specialized expertise in automation and control systems, including serial interfaces and IP address management.
* Proven leadership and team management skills in an automation commissioning environment.
* In\-depth knowledge of cause and effect engineering, control narratives, PLC/DCS programming, HMI design, alarm management, serial interfaces, and IP address allocations.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and troubleshooting skills specific to automation and control systems, serial interfaces, and IP addresses.

* Flexibility and adaptability to adapt to evolving project dynamics.
* Willingness to travel to project sites and work in diverse industrial settings.
* The role of the Industrial Commissioning Automation Lead is instrumental in ensuring the efficient and reliable operation of automation and control systems, including serial interfaces and IP address management, within industrial facilities. Strong leadership, strategic planning, multidisciplinary expertise, meticulous documentation, and an unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and efficiency are essential attributes for this role. Collaborating closely with the Project Director, clients, and various stakeholders, the Automation Lead plays a central role in achieving the successful commissioning and start\-up of complex industrial automation projects, making significant contributions to overall project success and client satisfaction.

title: Associate Data Scientist (Public Sector)
description:
#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


World Data Lab (WDL) is a fast\-growing data science B2B DaaS scaleup that takes strategic insights and data\-driven decision\-making to the next level by developing the most credible, global, and granular demographic and consumer spending forecasts.


Our insights help governments, businesses, and organizations make better decisions \- from shaping effective labor market policies to identifying the next million consumers in emerging markets. Everything we do is driven by one goal: creating meaningful, data\-powered impact.

#### **ABOUT THE ROLE**


Your mission is to contribute to advancing youth employment analytics through the Mastercard Foundation partnership by integrating diverse data sources, applying innovative methodologies, and supporting stakeholders in using data to achieve the goal of creating 30 million meaningful jobs for African youth by 2030\.

**Preferred location is** **Senegal****, potentially Kenya (Nairobi).**#### **THE CHALLENGE**


As an Associate Data Scientist, you will contribute to the full lifecycle of data analysis, from data scoping to delivering actionable insights that inform decision\-making. You will collaborate with data scientists within and outside Africa to drive impactful, data\-driven solutions that support youth employment initiatives.


Your key responsibilities include:

* **Data Preparation and Analysis**:


	+ Conduct data scoping to identify, gather, and evaluate relevant datasets.
	+ Clean, preprocess, and analyze labor market and demographic data from diverse sources, including national statistics offices and international organizations.
	+ Design and implement statistical and predictive models to generate actionable insights.
* **Visualization and Communication**:
	+ Develop dashboards, charts, and other visualizations to effectively communicate findings to technical and non\-technical audiences, including policymakers and private sector stakeholders.
	+ Contribute to the creation of blogs, reports, and academic papers to highlight insights and findings from the analysis.
* **Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement**:
	+ Work closely with senior data scientists to refine methodologies and ensure the quality of outputs.
	+ Engage with stakeholders to understand their data needs and ensure that insights are tailored to meet their objectives.
	+ Support the development and maintenance of user\-friendly data tools that enhance accessibility and usability of insights.

#### **YOUR PROFILE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred but not required.
* **2\-4 years of proven experience** in data analysis, data science, or a related field.
* Proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis and modeling.
* Experience with data visualization libraries (ggplot2, seaborn, or matplotlib) and advanced proficiency in MS Excel for data processing and visualization.
* Familiarity with statistical methods, machine learning techniques, and predictive modeling.
* Experience working with survey data
* Strong attention to detail across all aspects of data collection, analysis, and presentation.
* Excellent technical communication skills to translate complex insights into actionable recommendations.
* Collaborative and team\-oriented mindset, with the ability to work in diverse, multi\-disciplinary environments.
* Strategic thinker with problem\-solving abilities and capacity to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
* **Fluent in English** **and** **French** \- only candidates proficient in both languages will be considered.

**Additional Desirable Skills**:

* Knowledge of labor market trends and challenges in Africa, particularly the youth employment landscape.
* Familiarity with working in a startup or high\-growth environment, demonstrating adaptability and resilience.

#### **OUR OFFER**

* The opportunity to contribute to high\-impact projects addressing critical challenges in Africa, including youth employment and economic development.
* A dynamic, mission\-driven, and supportive team environment where your ideas and initiative are valued.
* Professional development opportunities (annual education budget), including access to advanced tools, training programs, and global networking.

#### **OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

* **Initial Screening:** A quick chat with our People \& Culture Manager and senior team member(s) to understand your background and expectations.
* **1st Interview:** Meet the hiring manager and showcase your skills.
* **2nd Interview:** Meet the SVP of Strategic Engagements.
* **Final Steps:** Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer.


We keep it simple and aim to wrap up the process within 3\-4 weeks.#### **About us**


World Data Lab (WDL), founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by visionary economic thought leaders and technologists, is a forward\-thinking data science SaaS company on a mission of *"Making Everyone Count."* We are dedicated to revolutionizing how the world understands and leverages data, ensuring that every individual, organization, and community has access to the insights they need to thrive. By using state\-of\-the\-art, peer\-reviewed methodologies and artificial intelligence, we deliver the most accurate models and forecasts on global spending power and demographic trends. Our proprietary data models enable businesses, organizations, and the general public to make informed decisions \- whether optimizing labor market policies or identifying emerging high\-growth markets.  

With a focus on creating meaningful impact, WDL’s leading products \- including population.io, worldpoverty.io, worldhunger.io, and World Data Pro \- have already reached millions worldwide, democratizing access to critical data. *At World Data Lab, we are looking for talented, driven individuals who thrive in dynamic, fast\-paced environments. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges and making a global impact, we want you on our team!*
